value.rationale: A complete all-time operator contraction norm for an infinite natural Markov-semigroup family, including exactly identifying adjacent extremizers and the strict curvature-to-spectral-gap acceleration, is structurally meaningful. The prior curvature value 2 determines only the best uniform exponential estimate and does not give the exact finite-time two-exponential profile or its strict submultiplicativity. The result supplies sharp reproducible benchmark data for graph transport semigroup theory.
